name: Push Ups
instructions: Start in a plank position with hands slightly wider than shoulder-width.
Keep your body in a straight line from head to heels.
Lower your chest toward the floor by bending your elbows.
Push back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of reps.
benefits: Can be modified for all levels
safety: Keep your core engaged and avoid sagging hips. Do not lock your elbows at the top.

name: Squats
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Keep your chest up and core tight.
Lower your body by bending your knees and pushing hips back.
Go down until thighs are parallel to the floor.
Push through your heels to return to standing.
safety: Keep knees aligned with toes. Do not let knees cave inward.

name: Bench Press
instructions: Lie flat on a bench with feet on the floor.
Grip the barbell slightly wider than shoulder-width.
Unrack the bar and lower it to mid-chest.
Press the bar back up until arms are extended.
Control the movement throughout.
safety: Always use a spotter for heavy lifts. Keep wrists straight and shoulders retracted.

name: Pull Ups
instructions: Hang from a pull-up bar with an overhand grip.
Engage your core and pull your shoulder blades down.
Pull your body up until your chin clears the bar.
Lower yourself with control.
Repeat.
safety: Avoid swinging. Use assisted variations if needed. Keep shoulders healthy.

name: Lunges
instructions: Stand upright with feet together.
Step forward with one leg and lower your body.
Front knee should be at 90 degrees.
Push back to the starting position.
Alternate legs.
safety: Keep front knee over ankle. Do not let the back knee slam the floor.

name: Plank
instructions: Start in a forearm plank position.
Keep elbows under shoulders.
Body should form a straight line.
Engage core and glutes.
Hold for the desired time.
safety: Avoid sagging hips or raising butt too high. Breathe steadily.

name: Bicep Curl
instructions: Stand with dumbbells at your sides.
Keep elbows close to your body.
Curl the weights up toward your shoulders.
Squeeze at the top.
Lower with control.
safety: Do not swing the weights. Keep controlled movement.

name: Shoulder Press
instructions: Sit or stand with dumbbells at shoulder height.
Press the weights overhead until arms are extended.
Lower back to shoulder height with control.
Keep core engaged throughout.
safety: Do not arch your back excessively. Keep neutral spine.

name: Deadlift
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width, bar over mid-foot.
Hinge at hips and grip the bar.
Keep back flat and core braced.
Drive through heels to stand up.
Lower the bar with control.
safety: Maintain neutral spine. Learn proper form before adding weight.

name: Mountain Climbers
instructions: Start in a high plank position.
Drive one knee toward your chest.
Quickly switch legs in a running motion.
Keep hips level and core tight.
Continue for the desired time.
safety: Keep shoulders over wrists. Avoid bouncing hips.

name: Jumping Jacks
instructions: Stand with feet together and arms at sides.
Jump while spreading legs and raising arms overhead.
Jump back to starting position.
Maintain a steady rhythm.
safety: Land softly. Modify by stepping instead of jumping if needed.

name: Leg Raises
instructions: Lie on your back with legs extended.
Place hands under lower back for support.
Raise legs until they are vertical.
Lower slowly without touching the floor.
Repeat.
safety: Press lower back into the floor. Avoid swinging legs.
